basics.name: Jack Saunders
basics.label: Senior Research Scientist | AI Avatars & Digital Humans
basics.summary: Senior Research Scientist at Tavus working on next-generation avatar rendering and generation. PhD from the University of Bath (ART-AI CDT & CAMERA). Founder of RealSync AI. Previously interned at Microsoft and Epic Games. Research focuses on video diffusion models, Gaussian Splatting, and audio-visual multimodal AI for photorealistic digital humans.

work.name: Tavus
work.summary: Working on next-generation avatar rendering and generation technology, with a focus on video diffusion models for photorealistic, real-time avatars.
highlights: Video diffusion models for photorealistic avatar generation
Autoregressive generation methods (Self-Forcing) for real-time deployment
Real-time avatar rendering and generation pipelines

work.name: Microsoft
work.summary: Research internship in the Mixed Reality & AI Lab. Led development of GASP (Gaussian Avatars with Synthetic Priors), a method for creating animatable 360-degree Gaussian avatars from a single image, published at CVPR 2025. Also contributed to RwR (Retrieve while Reasoning).
highlights: Led development of GASP: Gaussian Avatars with Synthetic Priors (CVPR 2025)
Real-time 360-degree animatable avatars from a single image at 70fps
Contributed to RwR: Retrieve while Reasoning (CVPR 2025)
Gaussian Splatting, synthetic data priors, avatar fitting

work.name: RealSync AI
work.summary: Founded RealSync AI to provide consultancy and science communication for avatar and digital human companies. Focus on lip-sync, talking face, and deepfake detection technologies.
highlights: Consultancy for avatar and digital human companies

work.name: DeepReel
work.summary: Employee #1 at DeepReel. Designed and implemented the core AI Avatar technology powering the product.
highlights: Designed and built core AI avatar pipeline from scratch

work.name: Epic Games
work.summary: Research internship focused on style transfer for 3D facial animation, which later became the basis for the FACTS paper at Eurographics 2024.

education.area: Computer Science — Deep Learning for Digital Humans

awards.title: E T Davis Prize for Pure Mathematics
awards.summary: Awarded to the student with the highest mark in Pure Mathematics in the final year of the BSc Mathematics course.

publications.name: GASP: Gaussian Avatars with Synthetic Priors
publications.summary: Real-time animatable Gaussian Splatting avatars from a single image or monocular video, using synthetic priors. Renders at 70fps on commercial hardware.

publications.name: DEAD: Data-Efficient Audiovisual Dubbing using Neural Rendering Priors
publications.summary: High-quality video dubbing from seconds of training data using a multi-person neural rendering prior.

publications.name: TalkLoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation for Speech-Driven Animation
publications.summary: Personalised speech-driven facial animation using LoRA adaptors with efficient transformer inference via chunking.

publications.name: FACTS: Facial Animation Creation using the Transfer of Styles
publications.summary: Style transfer for 3D facial animation — retargeting emotion and idiosyncratic speaking style while preserving lip sync.

publications.name: READ Avatars: Realistic Emotion-controllable Audio Driven Avatars
publications.summary: Emotion-controllable audio-driven avatars using neural texture models conditioned on emotion with adversarial training.
